instructions.description: Flag any secret-shaped literal, account number, region, model id or price written in code. Fake credentials in tests must be built from parts; the only literal allowed is the AWS documentation example key id.
A cloud or vendor SDK may be imported only inside its own kind module. Core logic must use the core's own interfaces.
Flag any role, permission or credential wider than the exact actions and resources needed, and any personal data or secret that can reach a model, a log or the audit trail unmasked.
Do not replace [0-9] with \d or [A-Za-z0-9_] with \w in a Python str pattern that validates input or redacts text: \d and \w also match non-ASCII characters unless re.ASCII is set.
